profile.headline: Senior QA Automation Engineer/Python Developer at IntraEdge
profile.jobTitle: Senior QA Automation Engineer/Python Backend Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Java/Selenium test automation engineer. Proven track record of leveraging strong security and automation knowledge in improving customer experience, reducing regression test time and minimizing production defects. I am able to succeed in both self-directed and team-oriented roles, and, as a lifelong learner, I can quickly pick up new skills and processes. I am familiar with Agile and Scrum methodology as well as Jira and Confluence. Experienced in supporting proprietary products built in AWS and Azure. Proven track record of increasing productivity while improving output quality.

positions.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer/Python Backend Developer
positions.description:
I am a Java developer specializing in test automation. I lead the effort to implement regression testing through automation. Utilizing BDD methodology and the Selenium framework, I created from scratch a test suite that is able to reduce regression testing time from several weeks to several hours.

I implemented an AI content scanning application that detects AI-generated text using multiple language models and third-party services. This operates in a serverless (on-demand) Kubernetes environment. I also optimized processing pipelines for cost efficiency, dynamically selecting detection models based on project requirements. As part of this, I built an extensible framework that allows seamless integration of future AI detection tools while maintaining high reliability and scalability.

positions.title: Technical Services Manager
positions.description: With accountability for leading a geographically distributed team to support more than 10 proprietary products in AWS, I have repeatedly improved productivity and efficiency while ensuring the highest level of customer service. By introducing a customer-facing, knowledge-centered support model with 400+ articles and implementing Scrum stand-up meetings, follow-up schedules, and metric dashboards, I reduced the case backlog by 80% and case resolution time by 25%. I have championed automation, introduced QA testing changes, and established key performance indicators (KPI). Through effective teamwork, I brought the defect process into Agile SDLC, reduced the time for prioritization, and improved resolution rates.

positions.title: Manager/Supervisor/Contractor
positions.description:
Here, I was promoted through multiple roles with increased leadership responsibility after demonstrating my commitment to customer success, my creative ability to conceptualize and implement process improvements based on existing and emerging technologies, and my extensive knowledge of business operations. I skillfully transformed customer escalations into opportunities to prove our commitment to customer success and drove employee engagement through improved hiring and training processes. A few highlights include:

► Overhauled knowledge base and outdated external customer notification application using SharePoint and Remedy.
► Reduced response time by 67% by automating incident communication process.
► Created enterprise-wide defect entrance template to augment accuracy and efficiency for multiple product lines.
► Slashed data validation processing time by 90% for Expedia.com using SQL database.
